reference.title: Supplemental Ransomware Information
reference.shortdesc: Additional resources to learn in-depth information for approaching, preventing, and raising awareness of ransomware attacks.

section.title: Supplemental Ransomware Information
section.p: The following resources can help you understand the complexities of ransomware attacks and how to prevent them.

strow.stentry: Comprehensive description of specific ransomware attacks, the abilities of certain malware, impacts on organizations, and best practices to respond to an ongoing attack.
Specific information and limits of how the FBI can work with organizations to respond to ransomware attacks.
FBI insight and response to ransomware attacks around the world, along with advice on how to prevent ransomware.
